core_obligations: Show the cokernel of the injective map Z_r(X) -> Z_r(X_{k^{perf}}) is p-power torsion (proof lines 372-380). Since X is quasi-compact, Z_r(X) is free with basis the integral closed subschemes of dimension r, and similarly for Z_r(X_{k^{perf}}) (proof lines 373-375). Since X_{k^{perf}} -> X is a homeomorphism, the pullback sends basis elements to positive multiples of basis elements, so Z_r(X) -> Z_r(X_{k^{perf}}) is injective with torsion cokernel (proof lines 376-377). Every cokernel element involves finitely many basis elements, each defined over a finite subextension of the perfect closure, and is p-power torsion by lemma-multiplicities-field-extension (tag 0H4F) (proof lines 378-379).
proof_roadmap: Freeness of both cycle groups on integral closed subschemes (proof lines 373-375).
Homeomorphism gives injectivity with torsion cokernel via the multiplicity picture (proof lines 376-377).
p-power refinement by the multiplicities-field-extension lemma (proof lines 378-379).
